tellings.difference: Credits Albert Stein and dates it to the 1950s-60s, with the account drawn from interview card files; the story credits Oscar Wolf.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell the S4 being's account: it belongs to a group from different star systems that monitors life, and it speaks of 'God'.

as_told.title: The S4 being describes a galactic team monitoring life, and 'God'

plain: A non-human being held at S4, a site near Area 51 in Nevada where some say recovered craft are kept, is said to have explained that it belonged to "a group of beings that were from different star systems in our galaxy," sent by "God" to watch over life. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this second-hand, as something he was told came from index cards recording interviews with the being. In one telling he credits a man named Oscar Wolf as his source; in another he credits a man named Albert Stein and places the interviews in the 1950s and 60s.
